Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, November 22 · NFL Week 11 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 20, 8:53 AM ET

Brock Purdy has the highest SPAGS projection in the Vikings at 49ers DraftKings Showdown: 19.1 points at $10,800 FLEX, 28.7 at captain for $16,200. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy holds 71% of the winning-lineup credit.

Justin Jefferson has the largest captain share: 19.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Jefferson at captain. The model gives him 9.3 targets on 27.4 routes. Brock Purdy is the next captain in line, at 17.2%. The model has him running 4.0 times.

San Francisco is a 3.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 25 for the 49ers and 21.5 for the Vikings.

Behind Purdy and Jefferson, the next projections are Christian McCaffrey (18.1, $11,800), Kirk Cousins (15.4, $9,400) and George Kittle (13.6, $8,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 20, 8:53 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Justin Jefferson, MIN WR ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Justin Jefferson holds 19.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 17.6-point SPAGS model projection becomes 26.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.3 targets on 27.4 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Jefferson averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 4.3 and a ceiling of 41.5. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 19.5% as the captain and 33.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Brock Purdy, SF QB ($10,800 FLEX / $16,200 CPT)

Brock Purdy holds 17.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $16,200 and the 19.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 28.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 4.0 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Purdy averaged 19.4 points with a simulated floor of 12.1 and a ceiling of 36.4. He holds 71% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.2% as the captain and 54.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Christian McCaffrey, SF RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Christian McCaffrey holds 15.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 18.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 27.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 12.6 carries and 5.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 18.1 points with a simulated floor of 6.5 and a ceiling of 35.1. He holds 57% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.5% as the captain and 42.0% in a FLEX spot.

Kirk Cousins, MIN QB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.0% as the captain and 45.7% in a FLEX spot.

George Kittle, SF TE ($8,400 FLEX / $12,600 CPT)

George Kittle carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 13.6 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model gives him 6.4 targets on 23.3 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Kittle averaged 13.8 points with a simulated floor of 2.0 and a ceiling of 32.1. He holds 43% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 14.3% as the captain and 28.5% in a FLEX spot.

T.J. Hockenson carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.8 DraftKings points for a $5,400 FLEX salary ($8,100 at captain). The model gives him 5.4 targets on 18.7 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Hockenson averaged 10.7 points with a simulated floor of 1.8 and a ceiling of 25.4. Across 10,000 simulations Samuel averaged 10.6 points with a simulated floor of 3.3 and a ceiling of 22.3. He holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 3.8% as the captain and 26.8% in a FLEX spot.

He holds 35% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 1.6% as the captain and 33.0% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Jennings averaged 5.9 points with a simulated floor of -0.2 and a ceiling of 14.1. Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

Justin Jefferson holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 19.5%, ahead of Brock Purdy (17.2%) and Christian McCaffrey (15.5%), across 10,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Vikings vs 49ers?

Build around T.J. Hockenson at captain with Brock Purdy, Christian McCaffrey and Kirk Cousins at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (20 of 10,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,900 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

Brock Purdy leads the SPAGS model at 19.1 DraftKings points for $10,800 at FLEX, or 28.7 points at captain for $16,200.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Vikings vs 49ers Showdown?

Christian McCaffrey is the most expensive player at $11,800 FLEX and $17,700 at captain. All 29 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Vikings vs 49ers DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Eddy Pineiro (8.6 points at $4,600), Jauan Jennings (5.9 points at $3,200) and Will Reichard (8.0 points at $5,000).

What is the Vikings vs 49ers spread and total?

The 49ers are a 3.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 46.5, with implied team totals of 25 for the 49ers and 21.5 for the Vikings.
